DsVPT: Internal combustion engine vehicle: the engine alone drives the wheels.
Hybrid electric vehicle (parallel): engine and electric motor drive the wheels; the battery is charged on board only.
Series hybrid electric vehicle: the electric motor drives the wheels; the engine runs a generator.
Plug-in hybrid electric vehicle (parallel): as the HEV, with a larger battery charged from the grid.
Series plug-in hybrid electric vehicle: as the SHEV, with a larger battery charged from the grid.
Battery electric vehicle: the electric motor alone drives the wheels.
Mild hybrid electric vehicle. Listed in the market catalogue; not calculated.
Fuel cell electric vehicle. Listed in the market catalogue; enters the calculation in the final stage.
